paragraphs.text: 1. To Agni send I forth my song, to him the Bull of all the folk:
So may he bear us past our foes.
2. Who from the distance far away shines brilliantly across the wastes:
So may he bear us past our foes.
3. The Bull with brightly-gleaming flame who utterly consumes the fiends
paragraphs.original: यो रक्षांसि निजूर्वति वृषा शुक्रेण शोचिषा ।
paragraphs.translit: yo rakṣāṃsi nijūrvati vṛṣā śukreṇa śociṣā |

paragraphs.text: So may he bear us past our foes.
4. Who looks on all existing things and comprehends them with his view:
paragraphs.original: यो विश्वाभि विपश्यति भुवना सं च पश्यति ।
paragraphs.translit: yo viśvābhi vipaśyati bhuvanā saṃ ca paśyati |

paragraphs.text: So may he bear us past our foes.
5. Resplendent Agni, who was born in farthest region of the air:
paragraphs.original: यो अस्य पारे रजसः शुक्रो अग्निरजायत ।
paragraphs.translit: yo asya pāre rajasaḥ śukro agnirajāyata |

paragraphs.text: So may he bear us past our foes.
